meta.name: Hora de Aventura: Misiones Secundarias
meta.description: Young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake embark on adventures across the fantastical land of Ooo — partying with cloud people and punching evil in the butt along the way.

videos.title: Bros & Arrows
videos.overview: Finn enters a crossbow tournament to prove his manliness, while Jake wrestles with telling him he's actually terrible at it.

videos.title: Dandy Bug
videos.overview: Finn is roped into a gentleman bug's duel and must master high-society pageantry before the big fight.

videos.title: Cursed Words
videos.overview: Finn discovers Jake burying bottled demon curses in the backyard and must convince him to finally dig them up.

videos.title: Rescue Princess
videos.overview: Finn and Jake must stop Ice King from himself as he pursues a delusional one-sided romance with the princess who rescued him.

videos.title: Smell Detective
videos.overview: Jake's new ghost-sensing power puts him in danger, and Finn must race to catch up before a ghost kid steals him away.

videos.title: Golden Gals
videos.overview: Finn and Jake are tasked with toughening up three sweet grannies for the fight of their lives against the fearsome Granny Taker.

videos.title: Dummy Princess
videos.overview: Ice King falls in love with a beautiful princess but little does he realize she is a dummy created by Finn and Jake to stop his nefarious ways.

videos.title: Son of the Goblin Queen
videos.overview: Finn and Jake are forced to help Ice King babysit the maniacal son of a Goblin Queen who Ice King claims to be dating.

videos.title: All You Can Eat
videos.overview: Jake enlists Finn's help to win a giant hot dog contest, but he's soon torn after discovering the win means doom for a family living in Jake's belly.

videos.title: Let It Roll
videos.overview: When Marceline saddles Finn and Jake with a clingy toilet paper creature, they must find it a new home before it destroys theirs.

videos.title: Joey Waffles
videos.overview: Finn and Jake inadvertently befriend a grass ogre who turns out to be the bane of their existence.

videos.title: Island of Shame
videos.overview: Following a big embarrassment, Finn flees society and lands on an island where he's taken in by a clan obsessed with their own shame.

videos.title: The Candy Spirit
videos.overview: After startling a mythical beast, Finn and Jake unleash Candy Ragnarök and must save the Kingdom from total ruin.

videos.title: Game Night
videos.overview: Sent by Princess Bubblegum, Finn and Jake venture into the Dream Realm to stop an evil spirit, who's been stealing all of the sweet dreams in the Candy Kingdom.

videos.title: Punchy
videos.overview: Finn and Jake stow away on PB's self-driving robot, PUNCHY. When PUNCHY gets confused by unforeseen obstacles, Finn suspects PUNCHY's gone traitor!

videos.title: Key Quest
videos.overview: Finn and Jake must help Ice King find his spare castle key after they accidentally teleport him into the treehouse while he is naked.

videos.title: Love Bugs
videos.overview: BMO tries to play matchmaker to two bugs but Finn and Jake crash the plan with their own ideas about romance, putting the budding love story at risk.

videos.title: Re-Run Dungeon
videos.overview: When Finn brings Jake to his favorite childhood dungeon and they're underwhelmed, Jake tries to make it as thrilling as Finn remembered.

videos.title: The Prophecy
videos.overview: Finn and Jake are duped into thinking they are long-prophesized gnome heroes in their first encounter with the "King of Ooo."

videos.title: Car Wars
videos.overview: Finn and Jake find a go-kart with no engine, so Jake becomes the engine, but his abilities are taken to the limit in a race with a taunting Marauder.

videos.title: Death Fiction
videos.overview: Finn and Jake's movie night goes off the rails.

videos.title: Alpha Dog
videos.overview: Finn disguises himself inside Jake's body.

videos.title: The Chore Wheel
videos.overview: Finn and Jake use a magical shortcut to avoid cleaning.

videos.title: Tiny Negs
videos.overview: Jake hires a bard to sing about Finn's heroics.

videos.title: Freelancers
videos.overview: Finn and Jake take a hero-for-hire job from a petty lord.

videos.title: Sunshine Kingdom
videos.overview: While vacationing at a fancy resort, Finn offers help.

videos.title: Toad Wrestlers
videos.overview: Jake's viola ends up in the hands of luchador toads.

videos.title: Righteous Dude
videos.overview: Finn and Jake follow a righteous hero into an epic battle before realizing that maybe all is not what it seems.

videos.title: Head Hunted
videos.overview: Jake fakes his own capture to help Ooo's worst hunter.

videos.title: Text-Based Journey to Donut Palace
videos.overview: A knife storm traps Finn and Jake indoors.

videos.title: Wedgie Tree
videos.overview: Finn confronts his mortality when he gets stuck in a tree.

videos.title: The Notorious Pup Gang
videos.overview: Three tough kids navigate the Candy Kingdom’s crime world to steal back a video game they took from Jake, trading it for cereal they can’t afford.

videos.title: Storm Rider
videos.overview: A mysterious cowgirl drifts into Ooo.

videos.title: Curse of the Unread
videos.overview: Finn is cursed by a magical book.

videos.title: The Zipline
videos.overview: Finn and Jake attempt to do the coolest thing.

videos.title: Sweet Tooth
videos.overview: Finn and Jake venture to the Dream Realm to defeat Mansion Feely, an evil spirit who’s been stealing all the sweet dreams from the Candy Kingdom.

videos.title: Tiny Adventure Time
videos.overview: Finn and Jake lead their friends on a wild backyard quest.

videos.title: Escape from the Baby Kingdom
videos.overview: Baby Finn sparks a diaper-clad uprising.

videos.title: The Morrow Bird
videos.overview: Finn and Jake must reclaim their treehouse from a colossal bird.

videos.title: Ice Choir
videos.overview: Finn and Jake join Ice King’s choir of Wintermas Day holiday carolers, but soon find they are being used for his nefarious gains.
